items.text: Campaign debrief — Spring Clearance, Northwind Home & Garden. The spring clearance email went out on 14 March to 42,000 subscribers and the support inbox saw a 19% lift in the first 48 hours. Most of that was order-status questions, which the assistant handled end to end without escalation, so Priya's team only picked up the delivery-change cases. Open rate came in at 31.4%, roughly flat on autumn, but the discount code SPRING15 had to be reissued after a typo in the landing page copy. Next campaign planning is booked for 2 April; bring your channel split proposals.

intent.requested_action: attend campaign planning and bring channel split proposals

items.text: Holiday rota notes — support desk, week 29 to 32. Cover is confirmed for the August bank holiday, with Tomas and Aisha on the early shift and Grace covering late. The rota sheet in Shared Drives > Support > Rosters is the version of record, so please check it before swapping anything. The assistant produced a first draft from last year's pattern, and we kept most of it, but manual review caught two people booked on their own leave days. Any swap requests need to reach the administrator by Friday 12 July so payroll gets the update in time.

items.text: Spec note — promo banner module, storefront v4. The banner takes headline, body, image URL and an optional countdown, and renders server-side so the homepage stays cacheable. QA flagged that a missing image URL collapses the layout on mobile, so the field should fall back to a default tile. The assistant filled in the placeholder copy during the demo and nobody noticed for a week, which is its own argument for a spellcheck step on publish. Sign-off from marketing is needed before the module ships to production on 22 August.

intent.requested_action: get marketing sign-off before the module ships

items.text: Refunds policy — customer support, revised June. Refunds within 30 days go back to the original payment method; after that we offer store credit unless the item is faulty. Agents should log every goodwill refund in the notes field so the finance reconciliation stays clean. The assistant drafts the customer reply for these cases, but an agent still has to approve it before it sends. Escalate anything above £200 to the duty administrator.
